clips.title: The story
paras: A summons reaches wandering night elf priests in Dun Morogh, calling them back to Darnassus. Maxan Anvol, the dwarven priest trainer, directs them to report to Priestess Alathea at the Temple of the Moon.

In Kharanos, Maxan Anvol takes note of the night elf's fortitude amid Dun Morogh's bitter cold, far from Teldrassil's serene forests. The dwarven priest trainer brings urgent word: a priestess of Elune passed through looking for the elf, carrying orders from Darnassus that demand an immediate return.

The road leads across the sea to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, among Teldrassil's sacred boughs. Priestess Alathea welcomes the traveler back to the Sisterhood of Elune, relieved to see another devotee return unscathed from foreign lands. She swiftly prepares the priest for the next rites of devotion, beginning with the Stars of Elune.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello there, friend. Good to see you travelin' far and wide to distant lands. No offense meant, but a lot o' your kind don't take well to these cold climates usually. Glad to see you're made of tougher stuff.

Not too long ago one of your priestesses was in here lookin' for you--said somethin' about you finding a Priestess Alathea in the Temple of the Moon back in Darnassus. Said it was important and you should head back there soon.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful, you've returned home, friend. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does Elune still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.
